req.title: Set cookie via path
req.statement: The system shall set a cookie of name=<name>, value=<value> and redirect to /cookies when GET /cookies/set/<name>/<value> is called.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that a GET request to /cookies/set/<name>/<value> should set a cookie and redirect to /cookies. The test suite includes a positive test to verify correct behavior, a negative test to handle invalid input, and a boundary test to check edge cases.

tests.name: test_set_cookie_positive
preconditions: The httpbin app is running and accessible.
expected: The Set-Cookie header is present with name=testname and value=testvalue.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/cookies/set/testname/testvalue')
assert response.status_code == 302
assert response.headers['Set-Cookie'].startswith('testname=testvalue')
assert response.headers['Location'] == '/cookies'

tests.name: test_set_cookie_negative
preconditions: The httpbin app is running and accessible.
expected: The response status code is 404 or 400 indicating a client error.
trace: Error handling for invalid path parameters
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/cookies/set//')
assert response.status_code in [400, 404]

tests.name: test_set_cookie_boundary
preconditions: The httpbin app is running and accessible.
expected: The Set-Cookie header is present with name=a and value=a.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/cookies/set/a/a')
assert response.status_code == 302
assert response.headers['Set-Cookie'].startswith('a=a')
assert response.headers['Location'] == '/cookies'
